title: Young Pinay surfer earns praise from world No. 1 after WSL duel
summary: A 15-year-old Filipino surfer earned words of praise from world No. 1 Molly Picklum after they faced off in the World Surf League (WSL) Championship Tour Philippines Pro in Cloud 9 this weekend.
